F1: get_item_key` calls `math.floor`/`math.ceil` on the `AuditLogEntry.datetime` value, which raises `TypeError` for any nonempty page, and `value_from_cursor` hands back the raw number instead of converting it to a datetime.
F2: member` is typed `RpcOrganizationMember | None`, and line 71 reads `.has_global_access` on it whether or not `optimized_pagination` was requested, so a request with no member raises `AttributeError` even on the default path.
F3: Cursor.from_string` accepts negative offsets, and with advanced features on they go straight into `queryset[negative:stop]`, which Django rejects with a `ValueError` (a 500 error) instead of a `BadPaginationError`.
